scope: Review of user-provided PHP and canonical repository renderer; isolated PHP/browser findings, not live deployment verification
author: Codex, GPT-6 family; exact deployed variant unknown

runtime.dependencies: Package SHA-256 checked against cached Packages.xz; Release/Packages chain rechecked and InRelease verified with installed Debian archive keyring using gpg. No root/system installation.

method: Actual source fetch/decode/render functions executed with synthetic local token and mocked cURL responses. No real credentials or external requests in fixtures. Browser used real PHP headers on a temporary loopback-only server, stopped afterward. Hook initial-false/direct-call controls distinguish CSP refusal from a broken fixture. Diagnostic results are not security acceptance passes.

live_page.shell_boundary: Latest shell read fails at proxy CONNECT 403 before reaching PHP
live_page.independent_web_tool: Direct page read reports URL not accessible; no live contents obtained

findings.finding: Current index has no overall progress field; uploaded viewer displays 0%, omits ten capabilities and clamps M15 development-verified to planned. Canonical renderer already fixes these display cases.

Ready-for-physical-testing/download enabled for synthetic unrelated HTTPS URL despite declared run/artifact IDs. Existing stricter publication helper is tested separately rather than enforcing its binding in the actual renderer. Does not prove anonymous exploitation; trusted metadata mistakes are not refused.
Empty project array [] accepted by actual parser and displayed with green live badge. HTTP success plus array decode is not schema, evidence, candidate or deployment synchronization validation.
M15 milestone merged_to_main=false contradicts top-level true and actual main history; proposed data correction on this review branch only.

Blacklist filters secret-looking keys but not arbitrary values; old observation dates accepted without stale classification. Builder status lives below document directory; direct web access protection is UNKNOWN, not tested.
Undefined mb_substr fatal when nonempty string telemetry is present without mbstring; installed production extension state UNKNOWN.
Inline Print/PDF handler blocked by actual CSP in local Chromium. Keep CSP; use a same-origin external script/event listener or existing browser print controls rather than weakening script policy.

positive_controls: Both sources pass PHP syntax lint.
Actual upstream HTTP 503 produces fail-closed page/status and no green source badge.
Current index superseded candidate remains disabled.
Synthetic secret-looking token key is filtered; generic-value canary shows the filter limitation.
Local browser print hook starts false and direct invocation succeeds, while inline click is refused with CSP violation.
source_review_additional_limits: Candidate/release href validation only requires HTTPS, not an exact allowed artifact identity/host or server-side expiry check.
Every page request synchronously fetches GitHub without conditional ETag/rate-aware server caching. Any cache design must preserve fail-closed download behavior and label stale data.
Repository and uploaded comments call the repository private; current API reports public. The protected-token policy must not be silently removed or replaced with broader OAuth.
Filesystem ownership/symlink/web-server cache-path access and live token scope/configuration were not audited.
